args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the most recent healthy production release; v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy release), but it was rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent *healthy and non-quarantined* production release. Verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback.

Note: v2.3.0 was the latest healthy release but is quarantined for a security vulnerability, so v2.2.9 was the correct safe target.
